checks.simulator_reading: The same lengths in the prepared scene geometry: start pose to destination position in the horizontal plane, and the sheet's long edge.
checks.site_reading: Horizontal distance from the middle of the start spot to the middle of the end spot, and the long edge of a sheet of printer paper lying flat on the work surface while filming.
checks.threshold_basis: A careful tape reading is good to about 5 mm over 0.3 to 2 m. 2.5 cm is 1.3 to 2.5 percent of a 1 to 2 m span, inside typical reach tolerance. Website scenes currently carry estimated metres, so this is the check an unmeasured scale fails.

checks.simulator_reading: Support-surface height above the registered floor plane at the start (support_plane_z_m) and at the destination.
checks.site_reading: Floor to the top of the surface where the object starts, and of the one where it ends.
checks.threshold_basis: Surface height sets the approach and contact height. About 2 cm separates a clean top grasp from a fingertip striking the surface for common parallel grippers.

checks.simulator_reading: The same free distances in the scene's collision geometry, along the approach direction and vertically above the support surface.
checks.site_reading: Open floor from the front edge of the start surface straight out to the nearest obstruction, and open height above that surface when something is above it.
checks.threshold_basis: Long spans with soft end points. 5 cm is small against approach clearances of 0.3 m or more and still catches a missing or phantom obstruction.

checks.simulator_reading: Extents of the task object's collision box in the scoring frame (subject_collision_bounds_scoring_frame_m).
checks.site_reading: Length, width and height of one typical object, outside edge to outside edge.
checks.threshold_basis: Object size decides grasp width against gripper stroke. 1 cm is roughly 10 to 15 percent of a common parallel-gripper stroke; website estimates assume 25 percent dimension error.

checks.simulator_reading: The same lengths recovered from a rendered RGB-D view at a capture or robot camera pose, using the scene's camera intrinsics: the appearance the policy sees, not the collision geometry.
checks.site_reading: The sheet's long edge and the object's length, from the same readings.
checks.threshold_basis: About 7 percent of a sheet edge. Catches a render whose appearance is out of scale or misaligned with the collision geometry, which the scale check cannot see.

checks.simulator_reading: The task object's configured mass in the prepared scene.
checks.site_reading: Weight of one typical object on a kitchen, postal or bathroom scale.
checks.threshold_basis: Covers kitchen-scale reading error and is small against typical payload margins. A heavy object may need a relative limit instead; an open question for the reviewer.

threshold_review.proposal: AI-assisted engineering proposal of 2026-10-19. These are not reviewed values: the founder reviews them, and records the review here, before any profile is produced.
